content: Ovarian hyperstimulation syndrome (OHSS) is a condition that can develop during or after fertility treatment. In rare cases, severe OHSS can lead to a rapid accumulation of fluid in the abdominal cavity, chest, and around the heart. Although a serious allergic reaction to this medication is uncommon, it is important to be aware of the possibility. This document does not provide a comprehensive list of potential side effects. If you are in the United States or Canada, consult your doctor for medical advice regarding side effects. Precautions: Before using this medication, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it, to other products containing follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH) or luteinizing hormone (LH), or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could trigger allergic reactions or other complications. This medication may cause dizziness, and consuming alcohol or marijuana (cannabis) can exacerbate this effect. Avoid driving, operating machinery, or engaging in activities requiring alertness until you are certain you can do so safely. Limit your intake of alcoholic beverages. This treatment may increase the likelihood of multiple births. Discontinue the use of this medication once you become pregnant, as it must not be used during pregnancy. It is currently unknown whether this drug passes into breast milk. Drug Interactions: Drug interactions can alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Maintain a list of all the products you use, including prescription and non-prescription drugs as well as herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. Overdose: In the event of an overdose with severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call emergency services (911) immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. Monitoring: While using this medication, regular laboratory and/or medical tests (e.g., blood hormone levels such as estradiol, vaginal ultrasounds) should be conducted to monitor your progress and detect any potential complications. Ensure you attend all scheduled medical and laboratory appointments. Lifestyle Changes: To enhance the effectiveness of this medication, consider making lifestyle changes such as limiting alcohol consumption and quitting smoking. Missed Dose: It is crucial to use this medication on a fixed schedule exactly as prescribed by your doctor. If you miss a dose, contact your doctor or pharmacist immediately for further instructions. Storage: Store this medication in the refrigerator or at room temperature, away from light. Do not freeze it. Avoid storing it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. Important Information: This document provides a summary and does not contain all possible information about this product. It does not guarantee that this product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. This information is not a substitute for individualized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
